title: Created foundations plan for column-type-aware-where feature
body:
Created TASK-column-type-aware-where-foundations.md — 5 phases, 25 steps. This plan fills the gap where the parts README claimed foundations were "completed" but none of the types/interfaces/storage changes existed in source code.

**Phase 1 (6 steps):** Type definitions — ColumnType, DbTable.colTypes, AppState.columnTypeOverrides, XLSXSheet.!data, barrel export
**Phase 2 (2 steps):** State default — columnTypeOverrides: {} in createAppState()
**Phase 3 (7 steps):** Uniform string storage — coerceForSQL() return type string|null, stringify numbers/booleans, remove numeric-string coercion
**Phase 4 (6 steps):** Test updates — sqldb.test.ts assertions must change from numeric to string expectations (3 specific tests identified), plus search other test files for breakage
**Phase 5 (4 steps):** Full validation gate — typecheck + lint + test

**Key discovery:** coerceForSQL is module-private, only called by insertRows() at sqldb.ts:77. No external callers. Safe to change return type.

**Test impact identified:** sqldb.test.ts has 3 tests that will break: (1) "should coerce numeric strings to numbers" expects 42/3.14 as numbers, (2) "should coerce boolean values" expects 1/0 as numbers, (3) "should insert all rows correctly" expects id:1/2/3 as numbers. All must change to string assertions.

**Updated artifacts:** parts README.md (foundations status: planned, not done), CONTRACTS.md (section headers updated to reference foundations plan).

title: Planning Part E: Export overlay rendering
body:
Creating Plan E for detail-bands-overlay: Export overlay rendering. Key decisions:
1. `buildExportFromDescriptors()` takes optional `isCsv` param — DD says "section headers not inserted for CSV" but current band layout path DOES include them in CSV. New model aligns with non-band path behavior (no section headers in CSV).
2. `exportAs()` band dispatch changes from `enabledBands.length > 0` check to `bandResult != null` check.
3. Totals row appended to `bandResult.parentRows` before calling `buildOverlayDescriptors()` — grouping layer handles it as a special ParentDescriptor.
4. `enrichRowsWithBandHeaders()` NOT removed — it's the non-band path fallback, not in DD removal list.
5. Test file: remove imports + suites for deleted functions (computeBandColSets, applyBandGroup, buildBandColumnLayout). Part F will add new tests for buildExportFromDescriptors.
6. 98 existing tests affected — ~65 tests for deleted functions removed, ~15 styleExportSheet tests kept, ~4 exportAs dispatch tests kept (updated), ~14 enrichRowsWithBandHeaders tests kept.

Added step to export it. (2) Validation match column check uses colMap (all resolvable parent columns) instead of projectedColsList (user-selected output columns). title: Created Plan B: Pipeline Stage Functions for temp-table-pipeline
body: Created TASK-temp-table-pipeline-B-stage-functions.md — 2 phases, 12 steps. Plan creates `report/pipeline-stages/` directory with six stage modules (base, lookups, calcs, filters, sorts, aggregation) plus shared types (StageContext, StageResult, StageFunction in base.ts). Phase 1 covers types + first three stages + tests + typecheck gate. Phase 2 covers remaining three stages + tests + final mandatory checks. Key research findings: (1) `buildJoins()` from sql-joins.ts can be reused directly by executeLookupStage — it already builds correct JOIN clauses from LookupSpec[], (2) `buildCalcExpressions()` returns `{alias, sql}[]` — clean fit for SELECT augmentation, (3) `buildWhere()` returns `{where, params}` — stage passes params to execQuery, (4) `resolveRef()` + `renderAggregateExpr()` compose for sort/aggregation SQL, (5) subtotals stage adapts buildSubtotalsQuery() pattern but reads from prevTableName instead of composing FROM/JOIN/WHERE. StageContext includes `outputColumns: string[]` (not in original CONTRACTS.md definition) — needed by stages to track available columns for pass-through decisions. CONTRACTS.md updated: Stage Function contracts marked "Planned", new "Query Layer Calls" section documents seven existing functions the stages import.

title: Created Plan C: Pipeline Engine & Integration for temp-table-pipeline
body: Created TASK-temp-table-pipeline-C-engine-integration.md — 2 phases, 9 steps. Plan creates PipelineEngine class in report/pipeline-engine.ts that orchestrates the six stage functions from Part B. Key decisions: (1) buildQueryPlan() refactored to return QueryPlanConfigs (removes sql/params/cols, adds sourceCatalog) — this breaks ~35 test assertions across 4 test files, all updated in-plan. (2) PipelineEngine.execute() accepts optional prebuiltConfigs to avoid double catalog building when runReport() needs configs for detail bands. (3) runReport() calls engine.cleanup() before execute() on every call — stage caching across calls is a future optimization. (4) Part C removes mode-runner functions (runDetailMode, runTotalsMode, etc.) and SQL dispatch — originally scoped to Part D, but tightly coupled to the buildQueryPlan refactoring. (5) preview-builder.ts simplified from 365 lines to ~80 lines — SELECT from pipeline temp tables. (6) deriveValidation() takes optional pipelineState parameter with colMap fallback for backward compatibility. (7) runDetailBandsMode() reads parent rows from pipelineState.tempTableNames[4] instead of plan.sql. Contracts ledger updated with 10 new engine contracts and 5 integration contracts.
